section.content: The invention provides a colimycin biosynthesis linked gene cluster, which has 44 gene open reading frames in total and has a nucleotide sequence with the full length of 89315 bp, wherein 5 genes are used for coding polyketide synthase and comprise 8 modules and 37 structural domains, 9 orfs related to polyketide synthesis extension units and modifications, 16 orfs related to glycosyl synthesis and 6 orfs related to glycosyl transfer are contained. Through gene cluster sequence information and structural analysis, genetic manipulation can be further carried out on the producing strain to obtain a novel and more effective antibiotic, for example, the PKS synthesis modular structure can be changed through genetic manipulation, the lactone ring post-modification change and the sugar gene replacement or modification are carried out, a novel macrolide antibiotic is created, the yield of the antibiotic can be improved through genetic manipulation on a resistance gene or a regulatory gene, and the amino acid sequence provided by the invention can be used for separating a required protein and can be used for antibody preparation.
